corrections_reviewed.purpose: Preserved the C1 due/order behavior while splitting the helper and test modules into bounded files.

resolved_findings.verification: The server query and response pagination both select tracker.endDate versus board.dueDate, apply the same workspace-local overdue date, and use the same status-terminal suppression. The client ordering helper now selects the same source-specific fields. The cross-source client regression and the 73-item server pagination controls cover the Asia/Jakarta boundary, Tracker Other overdue rows, due-today behavior, and rendered ordering.

The server cursor predicate and response comparator use workspace id, Board-before-Tracker source rank, numeric key suffix, and numeric id after the shared group/urgency/due/updated tuple. The client comparator mirrors that tuple. Tests cover OR-2 versus OR-10, workspace ids 2 versus 10, source rank, and page boundaries.

The dedicated Active candidate API omits q, preserves workspace/source/limit filters, follows opaque nextCursor values with a repeated-cursor guard, and bounds the drain at 20 pages. The server applies q only to All in both SQL and service filtering. T4 search is a pure Fuse candidate-window helper with no network or authorization discovery. The API regression keeps a typo match at item 73 after the first 50 and asserts q is absent from every Active URL, while All remains q-bearing through listMyWork.

The mode-neutral predicate matches only /my-work and slash-delimited descendants, so /my-workbench is excluded. The effect preserves the current Agent or Kanban mode on entry, resumes URL-driven synchronization on all seven mode-route exits, and leaves the existing exact /settings discriminator intact. T5 keeps the link in the global desktop/mobile section outside mode navigation.

List and reauthorized detail both use the same hydrated serializer and expose canMarkDone/markDoneReason. The pure canonical resolver reuses the existing Board column resolver and Tracker slot=done vocabulary, scopes inputs by workspace/board, and chooses deterministic position/id targets. Terminal completed/canceled status wins before mapping lookup; nonterminal missing mappings return missing_done_mapping and valid mappings return true/null without inventing pending. Mapping inputs are loaded in one columns query and one done-vocabulary query per candidate set, with tests proving list/detail parity and no per-row mapping queries. The exported resolver and response capability fields are available to the future T3/T8 consumers without implementing their mutation/UI responsibilities in Phase 1.
